$comment: Durable input for scripts/build-design-bundle.mjs. Edit this, not ds-bundle/.
$kit: Every component exposed on window.AuraReact, and the whole surface the pane indexes. An explicit list rather than `export * from '@vaadin/react-components'`: a barrel is unreviewable, and scripts/check-showcase.mjs holds this list to the installed package so a Vaadin release that adds or removes a component fails the build instead of drifting.
$omitted: In the kit but deliberately without a card of its own, and not demonstrated inside another card's `covers` either. Same contract as the OMITTED map in scripts/check-aura-drift.mjs: a reason each, and anything not listed here fails check-showcase.

omitted.Iconset: Defines an icon set from an SVG sprite; it renders nothing itself. What it produces is what the Icon card shows.

$components: A card each. `source` marks the six curated few-shot examples — their stories live in .design-sync/previews/ and the card ships the example plus its prompt. The rest are showcases: stories in .design-sync/showcase/, no curated example. `covers` names the kit components a card demonstrates besides its own, which is how sub-components stay accounted for without a card that would show them out of context.
